card.name: Start of 'anti-' drug class words
card.fires_on: Mostly the piece 'ant' beginning anti- drug class words (antiretrovirals, antacids, antiepileptic, antineoplastic) in drug interaction lists. Also fires on some brand-name pieces and section numbers.

modes.label: ant- of drug classes
modes.description: The 'ant' that starts a drug class word after a comma or 'or' in a list of interacting agents.
modes.example: Use histamine-2 receptor antagonists or<< ant>>acids if needed.

modes.label: Inside brand or generic names
modes.description: A middle piece of a product or drug name such as ZENBEX US or ospemifene.
modes.example: The use of PRISMASOL and PHOX<<ILL>>UM replacement solutions can affect blood glucose levels

modes.label: Stray pieces
modes.description: Odd pieces like a contraction ending or a section number digit in label text.
